ayahs.ar: ص࢜ وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ ۝١ؕ
ayahs.tr: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...

ayahs.ar: بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا فِيْ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ ۝٢
ayahs.tr: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

ayahs.ar: كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَّلَاتَ حِيْنَ مَنَاصٍ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

ayahs.ar: وَعَجِبُوْٓا اَنْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ مُّنْذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْؗ وَقَالَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ ۝٤ۖۚ
ayahs.tr: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

ayahs.ar: اَجَعَلَ الْاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ ۝٥
ayahs.tr: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

ayahs.ar: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْهُمْ اَنِ امْشُوْا وَاصْبِرُوْا عَلٰٓي اٰلِهَتِكُمْۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُّرَادُ ۝٦ۖۚ
ayahs.tr: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

ayahs.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةِۚۖ اِنْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ ۝٧ۖۚ
ayahs.tr: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

ayahs.ar: ءَاُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَاؕ بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْ ذِكْرِيْۚ بَلْ لَّمَّا يَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِ ۝٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيْزِ الْوَهَّابِ ۝٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

ayahs.ar: اَمْ لَهُمْ مُّلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاࣞ فَلْيَرْتَقُوْا فِي الْاَسْبَابِ ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

ayahs.ar: جُنْدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُوْمٌ مِّنَ الْاَحْزَابِ ۝١١
ayahs.tr: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْاَوْتَادِ ۝١٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُوْدُ وَقَوْمُ لُوْطٍ وَّاَصْحٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِؕ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ الْاَحْزَابُ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.

ayahs.ar: اِنْ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ ۝١٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ ۝١٥
ayahs.tr: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

ayahs.ar: اِصْبِرْ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الْاَيْدِۚ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْاِشْرَاقِ ۝١٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

ayahs.ar: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُوْرَةًؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

ayahs.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهٗ وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

ayahs.ar: وَهَلْ اَتٰىكَ نَبَو͏ٔ͏ُا الْخَصْمِۘ اِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ ۝٢١ۙ
ayahs.tr: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

ayahs.ar: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلٰي دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْۚ خَصْمٰنِ بَغٰي بَعْضُنَا عَلٰي بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي سَوَا࢜ءِ الصِّرَاطِ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا͏ٓ اَخِيْࣞ لَهٗ تِسْعٌ وَّتِسْعُوْنَ نَعْجَةً وَّلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌࣞ فَقَالَ اَكْفِلْنِيْهَا وَعَزَّنِيْ فِي الْخِطَابِ ۝٢٣
ayahs.tr: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُو͏ٔ͏َالِ نَعْجَتِكَ اِلٰي نِعَاجِهٖؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَا࢜ءِ لَيَبْغِيْ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰي بَعْضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيْلٌ مَّا هُمْؕ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَ ۝٢٤ࣛ
ayahs.tr: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَؕ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰي وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

ayahs.ar: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰكَ خَلِيْفَةً فِي الْاَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوٰي فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَضِلُّوْنَ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوْا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ ۝٢٦ࣖ
ayahs.tr: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًاؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنَ النَّارِ ۝٢٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِؗ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?

ayahs.ar: كِتٰبٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ اِلَيْكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوْٓا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيْمٰنَؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُؕ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ ۝٣٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: اِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الْجِيَادُ ۝٣١ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ اِنِّيْٓ اَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّيْۚ حَتّٰي تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ ۝٣٢ࣟ
ayahs.tr: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

ayahs.ar: رُدُّوْهَا عَلَيَّؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًاۢ بِالسُّوْقِ وَالْاَعْنَاقِ ۝٣٣
ayahs.tr: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَلْقَيْنَا عَلٰي كُرْسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.tr: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَهَبْ لِيْ مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢ͏ْبَغِيْ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِيْۚ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

ayahs.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيْحَ تَجْرِيْ بِاَمْرِهٖ رُخَا࢜ءً حَيْثُ اَصَابَ ۝٣٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

ayahs.ar: وَالشَّيٰطِيْنَ كُلَّ بَنَّا࢜ءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍ ۝٣٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

ayahs.ar: وَّاٰخَرِيْنَ مُقَرَّنِيْنَ فِي الْاَصْفَادِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.tr: And others bound together in shackles.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا عَطَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُنَا فَامْنُنْ اَوْ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ۝٣٩
ayahs.tr: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفٰي وَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ۝٤٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

ayahs.ar: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا͏ٓ اَيُّوْبَۘ اِذْ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَّعَذَابٍ ۝٤١ؕ
ayahs.tr: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

ayahs.ar: اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَۚ هٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ ۝٤٢
ayahs.tr: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗٓ اَهْلَهٗ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرٰي لِاُولِي الْاَلْبَابِ ۝٤٣
ayahs.tr: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

ayahs.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحْنَثْؕ اِنَّا وَجَدْنٰهُ صَابِرًاؕ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُؕ اِنَّهٗٓ اَوَّابٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاذْكُرْ عِبٰدَنَا͏ٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَاِسْحٰقَ وَيَعْقُوْبَ اُولِي الْاَيْدِيْ وَالْاَبْصَارِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.tr: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَخْلَصْنٰهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَي الدَّارِ ۝٤٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ۝٤٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

ayahs.ar: وَاذْكُرْ اِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِؕ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْاَخْيَارِ ۝٤٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا ذِكْرٌؕ وَاِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ لَحُسْنَ مَاٰبٍ ۝٤٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْاَبْوَابُ ۝٥٠ۚ
ayahs.tr: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيْرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ ۝٥١
ayahs.tr: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

ayahs.ar: وَعِنْدَهُمْ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرْفِ اَتْرَابٌ ۝٥٢
ayahs.tr: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا مَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ ۝٥٣
ayahs.tr: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنْ نَّفَادٍ ۝٥٤ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَاؕ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيْنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍ ۝٥٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصْلَوْنَهَاۚ فَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْمِهَادُ ۝٥٦
ayahs.tr: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَاۙ فَلْيَذُوْقُوْهُ حَمِيْمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌ ۝٥٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

ayahs.ar: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجٌ ۝٥٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْۚ لَا مَرْحَبًاۢ بِهِمْؕ اِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا النَّارِ ۝٥٩
ayahs.tr: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا بَلْ اَنْتُمْࣞ لَا مَرْحَبًاۢ بِكُمْؕ اَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوْهُ لَنَاۚ فَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ الْقَرَارُ ۝٦٠
ayahs.tr: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ ۝٦١
ayahs.tr: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰي رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَشْرَارِ ۝٦٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

ayahs.ar: اَتَّخَذْنٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْاَبْصَارُ ۝٦٣
ayahs.tr: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهْلِ النَّارِ ۝٦٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

ayahs.ar: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا مُنْذِرٌࣗۖ وَّمَا مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ ۝٦٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ ۝٦٦
ayahs.tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

ayahs.ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَو͏ٔ͏ٌا عَظِيْمٌ ۝٦٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: Say, "It is great news

ayahs.ar: اَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُوْنَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.tr: From which you turn away.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰٓي اِذْ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.tr: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

ayahs.ar: اِنْ يُّوْحٰٓي اِلَيَّ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٧٠
ayahs.tr: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ طِيْنٍ ۝٧١
ayahs.tr: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.tr: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَ ۝٧٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا͏ٓ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اِسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.tr: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّؕ اَسْتَكْبَرْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِيْنَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُؕ خَلَقْتَنِيْ مِنْ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ طِيْنٍ ۝٧٦
ayahs.tr: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌ ۝٧٧ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.

ayahs.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ۝٧٨
ayahs.tr: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ ۝٨٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ ۝٨١
ayahs.tr: Until the Day of the time well-known."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٨٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.tr: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّؗ وَالْحَقَّ اَقُوْلُ ۝٨٤ۚ
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

ayahs.ar: لَاَمْلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.tr: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ وَّمَا͏ٓ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِيْنَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

ayahs.ar: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.tr: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعْدَ حِيْنٍ ۝٨٨ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
